messages.htmlBody:
Shop at 0% installment with your UnionBank Credit Card.

Discover the smarter way to pay and shop for school essentials at 0% installment with UnionBank PayEasy.

UnionBank PayEasy offers 0% installment for 24 months with your UnionBank Credit Card, available in over 9,500 in-store merchants and outlets nationwide. For more details, visit the UnionBank PayEasy page.

0% interest is subject to bank approval and only applies if the monthly installment amount due is paid in full. 0% interest is applicable on select items only and is subject to the merchant partner's terms and conditions. Minimum spend requirement and applicable installment term vary per merchant. Installment Terms and Conditions vary per UnionBank Credit Card type.

Terms and Conditions apply. Per DTI Fair Trade Permit Nos. FTEB-249501, 255431, 255495, 252560, 256751, 254158, Series of 2026.

This email was sent by: UnionBank of the Philippines, UnionBank Plaza Building, San Antonio Pasig, Metro Manila, 1605, PH.
